quotes.text: Provide a visual representation of what your customers are purchasing.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: You can add images and descriptions through the Dashboard or the Checkout Sessions API.
When you create products through the API, you can specify product images using the [images](https://docs.stripe.com/api/products/create.md#create_product-images) parameter.

You can also specify images and create products directly on the Checkout Session by using the [product_data](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md#create_checkout_session-line_items-price_data-product_data) parameter.

findings: The full 2026-11-07 capture is only a 14-line variant index. It establishes the canonical topic and links to Full page ui=full-page and Embedded form ui=checkout-form content, but contains no Product API, Checkout Session, Dashboard, image rendering, payment or conversion behavior. Those linked variants were not pinned here and are navigation only (new raw lines 1-14).

The fully read 2026-04-20 paired capture, not the new index, documents images/descriptions on Checkout line items through Dashboard product editing, a Product images field referenced by a Checkout Session price ID, or inline Checkout Session price_data.product_data.images for dynamic/one-off products. It has separate hosted and embedded variants with corresponding Session examples; a Session creation example or success/return URL does not establish a completed payment (old raw lines 8-104, 106-202; source lines 11-43).

Current source accurately summarizes the older captured Dashboard/Product API/inline product_data mechanisms and links the Checkout concept. It already dates the source to 2026-04-20 and pins only the detailed older raw. Its behavioral statements should remain anchored to that dated source, not silently promoted to the new index (source lines 1-53; old raw lines 8-202; new raw lines 9-14).

The new variant-link labels and ui parameters differ from the older hosted payment-ui=stripe-hosted and embedded payment-ui=embedded-form headings. This is a navigation taxonomy change, not evidence that old ui_mode=embedded_page, Product images, or price_data.product_data are deprecated (old raw lines 10-14, 106-110, 155-195; new raw lines 9-14).
historical_claims_to_preserve: Preserve the 2026-04-20 hosted and embedded Dashboard/Product/Session image instructions as dated detailed authority; the 2026-11-07 variant index neither repeats nor negates them (old raw lines 8-202; new raw lines 9-14; source lines 4, 11-43).

Preserve separate Product, Price and Checkout Session identities: Product.images on a pre-created Product is referenced through a Price ID; inline price_data.product_data.images is supplied in Session creation. Hosted success_url and embedded return_url are illustrative navigation, not payment outcome proof (old raw lines 32-98, 128-195; source lines 17-43).
unresolved_questions: The new index points to full-page and embedded-form variant documents but supplies none of their behavior. Without separately pinned/read variants, their current API shape, UI-mode semantics and whether older image instructions still apply cannot be verified from this index (new raw lines 9-14; old raw lines 8-202).

findings: The source's Product images, Checkout Session inline product_data and hosted/embedded statements match the fully read 2026-04-20 capture; it has dated provenance and a Checkout concept route (source lines 1-53; old raw lines 8-202).
The new raw is an index with full-page and embedded-form links only; it provides no replacement behavioral details (new raw lines 9-14).
source_assessments.reason: No substantive new behavior or baseline material error is established; retain the existing dated detailed source and register the newer index as navigational raw reference without claiming the linked variants were reviewed.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/customization/product-images, the complete 2026-11-07 capture establishes only an Add product images variant index with Full page and Embedded form links; it does not itself establish image API parameters, rendering, prerequisites or payment states (new raw lines 5-14). The 2026-04-20 matched capture supplies the historical detail: a Dashboard-created or edited Product can have images and description; Product.images can be referenced by Checkout Session line_items.price, while dynamic one-off images can be supplied through Session price_data.product_data.images in distinct hosted and embedded examples (old raw lines 8-104, 106-202). Those Product, Price and Session identities should stay separate, and success_url or return_url is navigation rather than payment proof. source-stripe-checkout-product-images.md accurately reflects that dated old capture and has no material baseline contradiction (source lines 1-53).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/customization/product-images, the change is navigational: a 14-line variant index points to ui=full-page and ui=checkout-form without repeating detailed hosted/embedded guidance (new raw lines 9-14). There is no demonstrated substantive Product, Price, Checkout Session or payment-behavior delta. Keep source-stripe-checkout-product-images.md's 2026-04-20 Dashboard, Product.images, price ID and inline price_data.product_data.images claims dated to the paired capture (old raw lines 8-104, 106-202). The old payment-ui labels and ui_mode=embedded_page example differ from new link parameters, but neither path supersedes the other on this evidence. The linked variant content was not pinned or reviewed, and a Session creation, success_url or return_url is not payment success or proof of current variant behavior.
